reason: The text explicitly demonstrates King Hezekiah taking accountability for the state of Judah. He openly admits 'I have sinned' (חָטָאתִי) in his message to Sennacherib, tears his garments in repentance, enters the house of the Lord to seek divine guidance, and offers a detailed prayer before God acknowledging the crisis and petitioning for deliverance. These actions clearly show a leader taking responsibility for the dire circumstances facing his people, rather than avoiding accountability.
